boundary: Owner (distribution company): 34.5 kV line/cable to the metering kiosk at the north gate, incl. the utility meter and load-break switch. Contractor: cable from the kiosk outgoing terminals, 34.5 kV ring main unit and construction substations.
connection: 34.5 kV cable terminations at the outgoing side of the utility metering kiosk
isolation: Utility load-break switch in the kiosk; Contractor RMU incoming switch with earthing switch.
metering: Utility meter in the kiosk (construction energy paid by the Contractor, SC-045).
operating_conditions: 34.5 kV +/- 10 %, 5 MVA, prospective short-circuit 12.5 kA (distribution company).
protection: Contractor RMU incoming circuit breaker (overcurrent / earth fault) graded with the utility.
